name: Amazon EC2 p4de.24xlarge in us-east-1
description: Published default P4de allocation and regional family offering. Eight separate 80 GB A100 devices; no pooled-memory or training/inference-fit claim. Current account quota, AZ capacity, free memory, price and purchase scenario remain unknown.
